No rotation needed. Wormholes can be placed in a row. If you drag a belt across a straight belt, a wormhole is placed automatically.

It pays for everything, but differently: raw materials are worth almost nothing (iron ore — 0.001 cr), and the more expensive and complex the item, the larger the share of its price you get. So sell what your factory makes, not ore. Credits are needed for research in the tech tree. One market is not enough — build several and feed each with its own belt. How much was sold and how much is accumulating toward a whole credit is shown in the market window (E).

It can be placed right over a piece of belt.

Там же, в крафте ({key:craft}), сделайте: In the same crafting window ({key:craft}), make a [b]stone axe[/b]: 3 branches, 2 stones, 2 fiber. An axe chops trees many times faster. Out of branches and fiber? Gather more: they grow everywhere.
Выберите топор цифрой на панели внизу, ч: Pick the axe with a number key on the bottom bar to hold it in your hands.
Рубите деревья топором, пока они не упад: Chop trees with the axe until they fall: logs go straight into your backpack. Shouting "Timber!" is optional, but the corporation approves.
Брёвна нужны для верстака и досок. Пни т: Logs are needed for the workbench and planks. The axe leaves stumps alone: trees grow back from them ({key:rotate} with the axe in hand uproots stumps).
Откройте меню стройки ({key:build_menu}): Open the build menu ({key:build_menu}), section "Stations", and place a [b]workbench[/b]: 4 logs and 4 stones. Planks are made at the workbench.
Подойдите к верстаку и откройте его ({ke: Walk up to the workbench and open it ({key:interact}). Choose the [b]"Planks"[/b] recipe and put in logs: one log makes 3 planks. Take 20 planks: you'll need them for research and the workshop.
Двойной клик по брёвнам в рюкзаке перено: Double-click the logs in your backpack to move the whole stack into the open workbench.
Цветные пятна на земле — залежи руды. Во: Colored patches on the ground are ore deposits. Take the pickaxe and hit an [b]iron deposit[/b] until you have 10 ore. Somewhere in head office they are opening champagne right now.
Наведите курсор на залежь — подпись пока: Hover the cursor over a deposit: the label shows which ore it is.
Чёрные залежи — это уголь, лучшее раннее: Black deposits are coal, the best early fuel. Gather some. The environmental department asked us to tell you they are on vacation.
Нет угля рядом? Топливом подойдут и ветк: No coal nearby? Branches and logs work as fuel too.
Откройте меню стройки ({key:build_menu}): Open the build menu ({key:build_menu}) and place a [b]stone furnace[/b]: 20 stone. The first furnace is the first step to industrial greatness. And to heating bills.
Откройте печь ({key:interact}) и положит: Open the furnace ({key:interact}) and put in ore and fuel (coal, branches or logs). The furnace smelts ingots by itself: take 10 [b]iron ingots[/b]. Smells like progress. And a little burnt.
Двойной клик по стопке в рюкзаке перенос: Double-click a stack in your backpack to move it into the furnace whole.
Штаб — сердце базы и ваш личный офис с в: The HQ is the heart of the base and your personal office with a view of the wilderness. Everything stored in the HQ can be spent on building. The "Store in HQ" button in the backpack moves everything extra there.
Новые здания открываются в [b]дереве отк: New buildings are unlocked in the [b]research tree[/b] ({key:tech}). Unlock the [b]"Workshop"[/b]: click it and "Deliver": it takes 15 planks, 15 stone and 5 ingots. Research also costs [b]credits[/b]: the Workshop is 100 cr. Your starting credits cover the first unlocks.
Кнопка «Сдать» берёт нужное из рюкзака и: The "Deliver" button takes what's needed from the backpack and the HQ storage.
Поставьте [b]мастерскую[/b] ({key:build_: Place a [b]workshop[/b] ({key:build_menu}, section "Stations"): 10 planks, 10 stone, 5 ingots. The workshop makes parts: gears, wires, plates, ammo.
Откройте мастерскую ({key:interact}), вы: Open the workshop ({key:interact}), choose the [b]"Gear"[/b] recipe and put in ingots: one gear = 2 ingots. Make 6 gears: they're needed for the generator and the drill.
Слитков не хватает? Печь продолжает плав: Not enough ingots? The furnace keeps smelting: just give it more ore.
Снова дерево открытий ({key:tech}): откр: The research tree again ({key:tech}): unlock [b]"Mining"[/b]: 10 ingots and 10 planks. This adds the drill, the generator and power stations.
Поставьте [b]генератор[/b] рядом с залеж: Place a [b]generator[/b] near an ore deposit: 10 ingots, 10 stone, 2 gears. Open it ({key:interact}) and put in fuel: coal, logs or branches. The corporation generously covers the electricity bill.
Угольному генератору позже понадобится в: A coal generator will later need water through a pipe.
Поставьте [b]бур[/b] прямо на залежь руд: Place a [b]drill[/b] right on an ore deposit: 8 ingots, 4 gears, 4 planks. It mines ore by itself and outputs it through the [b]green port[/b]. It doesn't complain, doesn't ask for vacation and doesn't take lunch breaks.
Генератор даёт энергию, а до зданий её д: The generator makes power, and [b]power stations[/b] deliver it to buildings. Place a station ({key:build_menu}, section "Power") next to the drill: everything inside its circle gets power. Stations link to the generator and to each other at up to 8 cells. A station costs 2 planks and 2 wires.
Провода делаются в мастерской из медных: Wires are made at the workshop from copper ingots: smelt copper ore in the furnace, just like iron.
Нажмите {key:wire} — откроется [b]карта: Press {key:wire} to open the [b]power map[/b]: station circles and links. The drill must be inside a circle, and the station must be near the generator. Put fuel in the generator and the drill will start. The corporation generously covers the electricity bill.
Не хватает мощности? Ещё один генератор: Not enough power? Add another generator nearby or a higher-level station. Press {key:wire} again to close the map.
Протяните [b]конвейер[/b] ({key:build_me: Lay a [b]conveyor[/b] ({key:build_menu}) from the drill's green port to the furnace or the HQ: hold the left button and drag, turns are built automatically. Watching resources ride is an officially recognized form of rest. Buildings have ports: [color=#5cff8c]green[/color] is output, [color=#3fa9ff]blue[/color] is input. Belts connect only to them, any input accepts anything; there are as many inputs as different resources the building needs.
Поставили не туда? Нажмите {key:demolish: Placed it wrong? Press {key:demolish} to turn on [b]demolition[/b]. Click an extra building or a piece of belt: everything spent returns to your backpack. Hold the button and drag to demolish a whole line.
ПКМ или Esc — выйти из сноса. Штаб снест: RMB or Esc exits demolition. The HQ can't be demolished: it is too important for the reports.
Кредиты на открытия зарабатывает [b]Чёрн: Credits for research are earned by the [b]Black market[/b]. Place it ({key:build_menu}, section "Logistics") and feed it a belt or put items in by hand: credits go to your account. Raw materials are cheap, finished parts are worth much more. The corporation knows nothing about the market. Officially.
Каждый рынок принимает до 30 предметов в: Each market takes up to 30 items per minute: later you'll need several.
Местные машины-захватчики не оценили ваш: The local invader machines didn't appreciate your business plan. While the factory is small they come rarely (about once every half hour) and in small numbers, but better be ready. Unlock [b]"Defense"[/b] in the research tree ({key:tech}): 20 ingots and 30 stone.
Чем больше вы открываете, тем чаще и сил: The more you unlock, the more often and stronger the waves come, and later bosses arrive too. The wave timer is at the top of the screen.
Поставьте [b]турель[/b] рядом с базой. Е: Place a [b]turret[/b] near the base. It needs power, and ammo goes into the turret itself: open it (E) → "Put in" (the starting supply is in the HQ), later by belt or through the HQ channel. The turret handles negotiations for you.
Позже — мастерские роботов-строителей: о: Later: builder robot workshops. They rebuild what's broken by themselves.
Поздравляем, теперь вы официально полезн:
Congratulations, you are now officially a useful employee of the [b]Aloverdoz[/b] corporation. The task list on the right tells you what's next. New buildings are unlocked in the research tree ({key:tech}). All keys are in the "How to play" window ({key:help}).

The planet is yours. Make the board of directors shed a tear. Preferably of pride.
